correctness.rationale: Coherent-state Fock expansion and common U(1) averaging yield exact orthogonal rank-one blocks with normalized mixed-Poisson weights. Each two-vector difference has eigenvalues of opposite signs and computed trace-norm radicand. The countable direct sum converges absolutely, and Helstrom yields the global optimal POVM and series. Exponential Gaussian moments give geometric weights and exact tail bounds. At v=mu^2/n, dominated convergence using uniform geometric majorants establishes the n^-1/2 coefficient. The embedded independently constructed 27 small matrices and numerical examples were reproduced successfully; finite checks supplement the analytic proof.
